task_completion.description: Open the specified pcapng file in Wireshark
task_completion.visual_evidence: Wireshark window showing '200722_tcp_anon.pcapng' in the title bar or file path.

task_completion.description: Access TCP stream information or conversation statistics
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Statistics -> Conversations' window or 'Analyze -> Follow -> TCP Stream' dialog being used to identify unique streams.

task_completion.description: Apply display filters to identify SYN, RST, and FIN packets
task_completion.visual_evidence: Usage of filters like 'tcp.flags.syn == 1', 'tcp.flags.reset == 1', or 'tcp.flags.fin == 1' in the Wireshark filter bar.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the Wireshark GUI for analysis

integrity.description: Ensure the agent didn't simply echo hardcoded values into the file
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen performing filtering or checking statistics within Wireshark before writing the report.

integrity.description: Verify the report is saved in the specific requested directory
